text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having grown beyond expectations through 
the Junior Class, Inari One sets her 
sights on reaching the very "top" in both 
the regional and central circuits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she doesn't know any concrete 
ways to achieve her goal. Seeing this, the 
Trainer offers a suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What if we conquer the Tokyo Daishoten in 
the Classic Year, keep delivering results 
in Central GⅠs throughout the Senior Year, 
and aim for the "Umamusume of the Year" 
award?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, with Inari One's "top of the 
world" decided, she intended to make the 
Tokyo Daishoten her first goal, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To gain race experience at Oi Racecourse 
beforehand, the next target was set for 
the Japan Dirt Derby.
